reason: First run found ReferenceRateUSD empty in the Coin Metrics files for most assets during the DEV segments (e.g. sol, link, doge on 2022-01-01..03), so the preregistered supply series was empty for every name and SI1/SI2 had no position at all. No SI value has been computed or compared with returns. The other four trials ran and are unchanged by this amendment.
change: supply price = the perp daily close of the same day instead of ReferenceRateUSD. ln(supply[a]/supply[b]) does not depend on the 1000x unit of a perp, so the growth signal is the same quantity (perp close tracks the spot index within the basis).
trial_count: unchanged (6); the first run of SI with an empty series is not counted separately
